77333.body:

Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/market-makers)
Caption: 

# The deepest DeFi dataset is in your pocket

The DefiLlama App puts all of DeFi and TradFi in your pocket: Research Mode, Trade Thesis, wallet review and the deepest onchain data, available wherever you are.

Download the app and get 10 free LlamaAI queries each day to have your strongest week of research. No subscription required.

Claim 10 free queries (https://defillama.com/app)

^_Already subscribed? Just sign in with your existing account._^

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/86f35be8-ba01-4e76-b035-5b9694d2e416/image2_cropped.png?t=1786390570)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/app)
Caption: Backtest any strategy before risking capital

Only use [official download links](https://defillama.com/app). Rate the app to provide feedback and help others find the real one.



## The wild west of trading apps and launchpads

Of the 22 new protocols listed on DefiLlama this week, 6 were launchpads. The number of launchpads earning fees recently hit an all-time high.

Is the recent surge in launchpads and trading apps here to stay, or will this cohort of protocols fizzle out?

Analyzing 52 DefiLlama-tracked [launchpads](https://defillama.com/protocols/launchpad) and [trading apps](https://defillama.com/protocols/trading-app) with at least $1m in lifetime fees, one thing stands out: 90% of them have seen weekly fees drop over 80%.

The median launchpad has round-tripped 99% of its fee peak.

Analyze Categories (https://defillama.com/categories)

Both categories are subject to onchain cyclicality which looks something like this: a narrative or catalyst creates a burst of activity and results in a flurry of fees for the protocols positioned to capture it, then it dissipates.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/703dcc01-14c5-4561-9ee4-e5fd3a76fe9c/weekly-fees-launchpads-vs-trading-apps_2026-08-11.png?t=1786457727)
Caption: 

While several newer entrants to these categories (fomo, Pons, StonkBrokers to name a few) have not yet seen fee drawdowns of over 60%, there is no protocol in this dataset with a multi-quarter track record that hasn't seen an 80%+ fee drawdown at some point.

Even the most durable category leaders are down 85% from their ATH fee weeks, but are still earning: [Pumpfun earns $6m](https://defillama.com/protocol/pump.fun?groupBy=weekly) in weekly revenue and [Axiom earns $5m](https://defillama.com/protocol/axiom?groupBy=weekly). Both gave back a euphoric spike but have captured enough market share to remain successful.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Regulation is shifting from a stalled Congress to an activist SEC as institutions deepen their crypto footprint — yet prices wobble, with Bitcoin sliding below $64K on oil-driven macro fears and returning ETF outflows ahead of Wednesday's CPI. ⚖️ SEC Sets Aug. 14 Vote on Landmark 'Regulation Crypto' The SEC will hold an open meeting Friday to decide whether to propose "Regulation Crypto," a tailored offering framework that would let token projects raise capital without triggering full securities registration — and define when a project exits SEC jurisdiction. It's Chair Paul Atkins' first formal crypto rulemaking, and the all-Republican commission is expected to advance it to public comment. Read full story 🏛️ Senate Leaves Town Without CLARITY Act Vote, Eyes Sept. 15 The U.S. Senate departed for its August recess without even a procedural vote on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act, pushing a cloture motion to Sept. 15. The delay strips crypto of a hoped-for legislative catalyst and hands near-term momentum to the SEC's own rulemaking track. More details 🌍 Coinbase Wins Abu Dhabi License for Global Tokenization Hub Coinbase secured a Financial Services Permission from Abu Dhabi Global Market's FSRA to arrange deals and custody tokenized securities, making ADGM its international tokenization base outside the U.S. The tokens will be fully backed by underlying shares, carry voting and dividend rights, and trade straight from a wallet — no brokerage account required. Read more 📉 Strategy Sells Another 1,690 BTC to Fund STRC Buyback Michael Saylor's Strategy sold 1,690 BTC for $108.6M between Aug. 3–9 — its second straight week of sales — using the proceeds to repurchase STRC preferred stock and lift its USD reserve to $4.65B. The firm still holds 840,447 BTC, but repeat selling from crypto's largest corporate holder weighed on sentiment. See details 🏦 Bitcoin-Backed Lending Enters Its Institutional Era Public companies are increasingly borrowing against their bitcoin rather than selling it: MARA pledged 18,750 BTC (~$1.2B) to secure $600M in term loans from Coinbase Credit and Two Prime. Lenders now offer larger, longer and more bespoke facilities — a sign BTC-collateralized credit is maturing into a TradFi-style product.
